policy.purpose: Define benchmark evidence boundaries before any timing, optimization, assembly, hardware acceleration, or external crypto library work lands.
policy.default_execution: manifest-validation-only; make test-unit must not depend on machine speed or timing thresholds

platform_tiers.allowed_claim: benchmark harness policy is present and no timing is executed

platform_tiers.evidence: future opt-in PC timing metadata plus correctness gate
platform_tiers.allowed_claim: PC-only timing sample, not MCU performance
benchmark harness compiles for STM32U5, not timing or hardware pass

platform_tiers.evidence: future board run record with clock/compiler/interrupt/cache/sample metadata
platform_tiers.allowed_claim: recorded target measurement for the named board and commit only

algorithm_groups.benchmark_input_policy: fixed public test vectors only; never production data or customer secret material
fixed public messages and non-secret benchmark keys only
fixed non-secret keys/nonces for measurement only; no production nonce/key reuse claim
fixed benchmark seed only; no entropy-source, secret, token, or key generation claim
policy boundary only unless separate root/security/provenance decision exists
